clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns As Vice President Of Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially submitted his resignation letter to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) on Thursday.
MPR Chairman Ahmad Muzani confirmed receipt of the document and stated that the institution will immediately begin processing the transition.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Chief Details Illegal Surveillance Investigation
aiSummaryBullets: Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto outlined the chronology and methodology of alleged illegal surveillance targeting the President and other officials.
The investigation reportedly implicates former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo as the individual who issued the initial verbal orders.

clusters.headline: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Arrives At Parliament Complex
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka arrived at the parliament complex in Jakarta on Thursday.
The official was observed wearing a suit with a red tie and carrying a white document folder.

clusters.headline: Indonesian House Holds Plenary Session On Vice President Impeachment
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian House of Representatives scheduled a plenary session to deliberate on a proposal for an opinion-stating right regarding the Vice President.
A total of 120 members from eight factions have officially submitted the proposal, which centers on claims that the Vice President no longer meets office requirements.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Police Deny Reports Regarding Arrest Of Former KPK Chief
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Metro Police officials explicitly denied rumors circulating regarding the arrest of former KPK Chairman Firli Bahuri.
Authorities clarified that investigators were present to coordinate a follow-up appearance rather than to conduct an arrest.

clusters.headline: Indonesian House Schedules Plenary Session Over Impeachment Inquiry
aiSummaryBullets: A total of 120 members of the House of Representatives have formally proposed an inquiry regarding Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The legislative body is scheduled to discuss the proposal during a plenary session held to address the submission.

clusters.headline: Joko Widodo Responds To Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resignation News
aiSummaryBullets: Former President Joko Widodo spoke publicly following reports that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation.
Jokowi advised that political positions are temporary and stated he continues to support the administration of President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Visits Aceh For Flag Event And Mosque Inauguration
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially inaugurated the Jade Mosque located in Aceh.
The visit included an event where residents unfurled a 24-kilometer national flag to establish a new record.

clusters.headline: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Meets President At Palace
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka held a meeting with President Prabowo Subianto at the Merdeka Palace.
Following the meeting, the Vice President proceeded to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) building.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Investigate Treason Allegations Against Ex-Chief
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto announced a criminal investigation into treason allegations linked to illegal wiretapping.
Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo is identified as a primary subject in the ongoing legal proceedings.
